Interface QueueLogic

All Known Implementing Classes:
MM1dLogic, MM1Logic, MMNdLogic, MMNLogic
public interface QueueLogic
This interface represent the logic of the queue types: the arrival and the execution of the process/job. This changed with respect to inputs arrival rate(lambda), service time, number of station capacity or number of servers. Each queue type could have different inputs.
